status: Bandit simulator complete — theory meets practice
key_finding: Thompson Sampling outperforms UCB1 and epsilon-greedy across both Bernoulli and Gaussian reward settings. The Bayesian probability matching approach naturally allocates exploration budget to uncertain arms, achieving lower cumulative regret. With well-separated arms, 95%+ optimal selection in 500 pulls; with close means, all strategies converge slowly confirming gap-dependent regret bounds.
